title: Kimi Code Plugin Manifest
description: Plugin manifest for the current Kimi CLI (kimi-code), looked up as kimi.plugin.json then .kimi-plugin/plugin.json in the plugin root. Authored from MoonshotAI's official documentation and source; Kimi publishes no reachable JSON Schema (its shipped manifest declares https://kimi.com/schemas/kimi.plugin.schema.json, which serves HTML).
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: MoonshotAI/kimi-code docs/en/customization/plugins.md and packages/agent-core-v2/src/app/plugin/{manifest,types,marketplace}.ts. The legacy MoonshotAI/kimi-cli plugin system is a different format: root plugin.json with a tools array, no marketplace, no skills/agents components (see spec.md). fields listed in UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME_FIELDS (tools, apps, inject, configFile, config_file, bootstrap) emit an info diagnostic and are ignored.

name.description: Plugin identifier; normalized to lowercase. The only field whose failure invalidates the manifest.

author.description: Author as a bare name or a structured record; a bare string is coerced to { name }.

skills.description: ./-prefixed paths that must resolve inside the plugin root. Defaults to a root SKILL.md when present.

agents.description: ./-prefixed paths to agent files. agents/ is auto-discovered when omitted.

sessionStart.description: Loads a named plugin skill at new or resumed session start.

skillInstructions.description: Extra instructions appended whenever a skill from this plugin loads.

systemPrompt.description: Inline system-prompt contribution; capped at 32 KB.

systemPromptPath.description: ./ path to a UTF-8 text file appended after systemPrompt; capped at 32 KB and read at install or reload.

mcpServers.description: Inline MCP server map. Kimi declares MCP only inline; there is no .mcp.json companion file. A command containing / must start with ./.

hooks.description: Inline hook definitions; there is no hooks/hooks.json convention.

commands.description: ./ directories or .md files exposed as slash commands namespaced <plugin>:<command>.

interface.description: Listing metadata; dropped entirely when every field is absent.

tools.description: Legacy kimi-cli field; emits an info diagnostic and is ignored by kimi-code.
